Not for the first time, Andronux wondered how someone as important as himself had gotten stuck in such a cramped, miserable office. Fortunately, he spent little time in here.

"Ah, Foreman Janz," he said as a short, robust Holnareem squeezed in through the pitiful doorway (which had no door). "You're looking well."

"You sent for me, sir," he mumbled, not especially interested in his superior's 'charm.' He, like his crew, had been on half rations for a year.

"Yes indeed. It would seem that my brother has discovered the red mountain, and is now in need of reinforcements."

In spite of himself, the foreman cracked a smile. "Has he indeed, sir."

"Yes." Andronux chuckled. His brother's ambitions had long been a source of amusement for him. "In reality, I would wager he's fallen into some mud hole and needs someone to pull him out."

The look of amusement soon departed Foreman Janz's face. No meeting with Andronux had ever ended pleasantly, and he doubted this would be an exception.

"I'm giving you my seal. Go to the dungeons. Find two dozen slaggards, thieves, what have you. Outfit them and send them to my brother." After fussing at his desk for a moment, he thrust the necessary paperwork at Janz.

"Very good, sir."

"Oh... one other thing. Send in those two idiots; you know the ones."

Janz nodded. He did indeed know which ones.

Andronux leaned back in the massive stone chair and sighed. There were two possibilities: his brother was lying, or telling the truth. If lying, he would continue to be a burden (as he always had been). If telling the truth, he would be an even greater burden. He was obligated under the law to obey his requests, but he had to be careful. If he made the mistake of being too generous...

And then there was the matter of the 'second letter.' It was clearly a forgery, but he couldn't take it lightly. Most likely, Koniguldon had foolishly struck a bargain with the absurd creature who had delivered the scrolls... either that, or he was being played for a fool. But he would honor the 'order,' if just barely.

There was a thud as one of the awkward pair of Holnareem tried to enter his office. It was soon followed by another. A crack appeared above the door from where an oversized head and collided with the other side of the wall.

"Fatboi and Lillmon, stop bickering and come inside. I have work for you. It will take you quite far afield, I'm afraid..."
